// Jittered-grid scattering: one point per grid cell, displaced from the cell
// center by JitterAmount in [0, 1] (0 = regular grid, 1 = anywhere in the
// cell).
type JitteredGridPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector2;
    JitterAmount: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}
